messages:
Priya: Quick async — landing header-based tenant routing fix today. Merged branch into staging-canary but waiting on certs for canary region.

Priya: What I did: ran canary locally, validated routing + KV cache behavior.
Blockers: missing TLS certs for canary-1 region (cloud vendor hasn't provisioned).
Today: will watch canary, address CR comments on #4182, and coordinate certs with @Liam.

Liam: I can add the certs, send me the vault path and thumbprint. ping when you're ready :+1:

Priya: vault path is /secret/staging/certs/canary-1. Thumbprint in the Jenkins job output. I'll DM that.

Sam: Reviewing PR #4182 now. Small nit: increase retry on 429 backoff from 100ms to 200ms and add jitter. Also add a unit test for route fallback.

Jorge: FYI I noticed ~30m of 503s on /v1/embed yesterday at 03:10 UTC — looks like a rate-policy misrule on ingress. I pushed a staging patch (policy id rp-ingress-3) that should stop the cascade.

Olivia: On-call FYI — I've muted noisy alerts for that spike and will keep an eye on SLO graphs.

Priya: thanks all. @Liam please post when certs are in vault so I can flip the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: canary-2026-03-18-13:04. Hosts healthy: 2/3. Monitor: https://dashboard.redwood.example/canaries/canary-2026-03-18-13:04

Sam: noted on 429 change, will push a quick follow-up commit.

Liam: Certs uploaded to /secret/staging/certs/canary-1, KV version 7. Tested TLS handshake against canary host OK.

Priya: flipping canary now — will post final status in 10m.

deploy-bot: Canary health update: 3/3 hosts healthy, latency stable, no increase in 5xx in last 5m.

Priya: canary looks good, promoting to blue. Thanks everyone :tada:
